data.body: **[P2] Bound admission sizing by the lane byte budget.** `_estimate_retained_size()` always walks the entire graph and bulk-extends every container before this call compares the result with 16 MB. A large input or result can therefore allocate a traversal stack proportional to the record and stall or exhaust the checkpoint thread even though every lane will reject it. Pass the maximum lane budget into the estimator, return a saturated value as soon as it is exceeded, and test a very large shallow container.
